# Demo

> A demo site, for the tests.

This file indexes the project for coding agents reading a local copy of it, in the llms.txt format: its guides, then every module, type, and member its Luau source exposes. Links are relative to this file, and each API entry links the lines that declare it, directly below its doc comment.

Keep it current: after changing the public surface, a doc comment, or a guide, run `npx luaudocs@<version> llms` in this directory and commit the result. When nothing listed here changed, the command leaves the file as it is.

## Guides

- [Getting Started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): Install it, point it at a module, ship the site.
- [Errors](docs/guide/reference/errors.md): What the extractor reports, and why.

## Sample

- [Sample](src/init.luau): A small sample library, written to exercise the renderer: every construct below is one the doc-model diff or a page snapshot pins.
- [`type Action`](src/init.luau#L39-L41)
- [`Sample.Clean: Type.Symbol`](src/init.luau#L12): A symbol marking cleanup entries passed to [Sample.edit]
- [`Sample.Color: Color`](src/Color.luau): [Module]
- [`Sample.Interpolate: Interpolate`](src/Interpolate.luau): [Module]
- [`Sample.Query: Query`](src/Query.luau): [Module]
- [`Sample.State: State`](src/State.luau): [Module]
- [`Sample.Type: Type`](src/Type.luau): [Module]
- [`Sample.Linear: Linear`](src/Color.luau#L27): [from Color] The linear-light helpers, lifted out of [Color]
- [`Sample.deferUpdates(value: boolean?)`](src/init.luau#L33-L35): Sets the deferred-update behaviour, defaults to false
- [`Sample.action(callback: (string) -> ()): Action`](src/init.luau#L46-L48): Creates an action that runs logic against a named target
- [`Sample.compute<T>(computation: () -> T): State.State<T>`](src/init.luau#L51-L55): Creates a computed state that tracks its dependencies automatically
- [`Sample.state<T>(initialValue: T?): State.State<T>`](src/init.luau#L58-L66): Creates a new state holding an initial value
- [`Sample.edit<T>(target: T, properties: Type.Dict<any>): T`](src/init.luau#L69-L74): Applies a table of properties to an existing target
- [`Sample.new(className: string): (Type.Dict<any>) -> string`](src/init.luau#L77-L83): Creates a target of the given class and applies a table of properties to it
- [`Sample.isState(object: any): boolean`](src/State.luau#L7-L9): [from State] Checks whether an object is a state
- [`Sample.raw<T>(object: T): any`](src/State.luau#L12-L14): [from State] Gets the raw value of a state, or the input itself when it is not a state
- [`Sample.fromGamma(channel: number): number`](src/Color.luau#L4-L6): [from Color] Reaches a member *through* a nested class: two path segments, which no lookup by bare name can spell

## Sample.Color

- [Color](src/Color.luau): Two nested tables, so each becomes its own section on the page.
- [`Color.Linear`](src/Color.luau#L27)
- [`Color.Linear.fromGamma(channel: number): number`](src/Color.luau#L4-L6): Converts a gamma-encoded channel to linear
- [`Color.Linear.toGamma(channel: number): number`](src/Color.luau#L9-L11): Converts a linear channel back to gamma-encoded
- [`Color.Polar`](src/Color.luau#L28)
- [`Color.Polar.fromCartesian(x: number, y: number): number`](src/Color.luau#L16-L18): Converts cartesian coordinates to an angle
- [`Color.Polar.toCartesian(angle: number): (number, number)`](src/Color.luau#L21-L23): Converts an angle back to cartesian coordinates

## Sample.Interpolate

- [Interpolate](src/Interpolate.luau): Blends two values, falling back to a hard switch at the midpoint.
- [`Interpolate(a: any, b: any, t: number): any`](src/Interpolate.luau#L3-L8)

## Sample.Query

- [Query](src/Query.luau): Tiny state-query helpers, documented in the plain block style.
- [`Query.countStates(objects: { any }): number`](src/Query.luau#L25): Counts how many of the given values are states.
- [`Query.__call(self: any, objects: { any }): number`](src/Query.luau#L34-L36): Calling the module counts states directly: `Query(objects)`.

## Sample.State

- [State](src/State.luau): Constructors: `Sample.compute`, `Sample.state`.
- [`type StateData<T>`](src/State.luau#L16-L23)
- [`type State<T> = typeof(setmetatable({} :: StateData<T>, State))`](src/State.luau#L25): A state is its data plus this metatable: the class type the page is built from.
- [`type Stateful<T> = T | State<T>`](src/State.luau#L27): Either a plain value or a state holding one.
- [`State.deferUpdates: boolean`](src/State.luau#L3)
- [`State.isState(object: any): boolean`](src/State.luau#L7-L9): Checks whether an object is a state
- [`State.raw<T>(object: T): any`](src/State.luau#L12-L14): Gets the raw value of a state, or the input itself when it is not a state
- [`State:Connect(callback: Type.Function): Type.Function`](src/State.luau#L44-L49): Adds a hook to run whenever the value changes, returning a disconnect function
- [`State:Destroy()`](src/State.luau#L52-L56): Destroys the state, clearing its dependencies and hooks

## Sample.Type

- [Type](src/Type.luau): Shared aliases, and the only module that names Roblox classes: the `New<>` arms below are what `linkRobloxTypes` resolves against, so engine linking is covered in one place instead of leaking into every other fixture module.
- [`type Function = (...any) -> ...any`](src/Type.luau#L5)
- [`type Dict<T> = { [T]: any }`](src/Type.luau#L6)
- [`type Set<T> = { [T]: boolean }`](src/Type.luau#L7)
- [`type Symbol = { type: "Symbol" }`](src/Type.luau#L8)
- [`type New<Name, Class> = (Name) -> (Class & Dict<any>) -> Class`](src/Type.luau#L11): Maps a class name to a constructor for that class.
- [`type Constructor = New<"Frame", Frame> & New<string, Instance>`](src/Type.luau#L15): One arm per resolvable form: a string-literal class name, and the `string` fallback whose class is named as a plain identifier.
